cohort: The study included 62 neonates diagnosed with Meconium Aspiration Syndrome (MAS), divided into two groups of 31 participants each, admitted to Huai'an Maternity and Child Healthcare Hospital between January 2018 and June 2020.
finding: Intratracheal instillation of budesonide suspension significantly alleviated oxidative stress (lower OSI and 8-Isoprostane) and shortened the duration of invasive respiratory support in neonates with MAS compared to normal saline.
